Phase 37 plan submitted: docs/phases/cockpit-launchpad-lead-conversation-31.md (branch phase-37-cockpit-launchpad; release 3.1.0). Source: the arbiter's user walk-through today — `tagteam serve` on an idle project dead-ends (empty Needs-you, old Feed, no way to start), the CLI says "Dashboard" while the tab says "Cockpit", and two `tagteam serve` processes on 8080 shadowed each other silently; the arbiter's ask: "I want to be in a session or be able to talk to my lead and start one — the same capability in the UI as in the terminal: brainstorm, plan, hand off, follow up, close out."

Designed flow-first (ux-design-guide; plan §UX design): principles = empty states teach, visibility of status, smart defaults/Tesler, recognition + one primary action. Flow: bare `tagteam serve` = cockpit with an honest banner and port-collision refusal → Start card (next roadmap phase inferred; primary Start headless = start watcher + send the lead "/handoff start <slug>" as the first Lead-panel message; secondary Launch terminals = `tagteam session start` + copyable command; not-set-up → quickstart hint) → Lead panel (conversation with the lead through its own CLI via the Phase 31 adapters: resumable — Claude --session-id/--resume set by the engine, Codex `exec resume` when supported else budgeted transcript replay — streamed over SSE, transcript.md + events on disk, DB index (schema v7 additive: conversations, conversation_turns, usage.kind), same least-privilege permissions as headless turns, lead lock via the shared inflight marker kind=conversation so the watcher never dispatches the lead's cycle turn on top and Send is refused while the lead's cycle turn is in flight; pause does not block talking) → watcher chip Start/Stop → approved-state "Next phase" → hub idle rows link to the Start card (hub stays read-only). CLI twin `tagteam lead "msg" [--new|--conversation ID] / --list`.

Compatibility: one deliberate flip (bare serve → cockpit; `--theme saloon` byte-identical to today's bare serve, test retargeted); everything else additive. Scope A–F with tests (serve default/banner/collision, start_payload matrix, launch actions incl. refuse-when-running and manual-backend commands, lead chat end-to-end on the fake agent with resume argv assertions + Codex replay path + lock/409 + cancel + paused-allowed, CLI twin, schema v7 additivity, docs drift/coverage/screenshot). In-cycle gates include a real `claude -p` conversation dogfood on this repo and the user walk-through with seeded screenshots; post-approval unchanged (harness-only installed-wheel check).

Three open questions for you: Q1 Codex continuity (depend on `exec resume` or replay-only), Q2 refuse vs queue Send while the lead's cycle turn is in flight (plan refuses → Interject), Q3 phase.start as a conversation message (plan) vs a dedicated engine dispatch.
